player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee Chopsticks. Markaad soo jeesato, dooro mid ka mid ah: + Weerar: '[attack M O]' halkaas oo M = gacantaada (0 ama 1), O = gacanta ka soo horjeedka (0 ama 1). - Tirada gacmaha ka soo horjeedka ayaa kordha gacantaada; haddii > = 5, waxay noqoneysaa 0. + Split: '[split L R] 'si aad u kala qaybiso fartaada guud ahaan L iyo R (L + R = wadartaada). Ku jawaab mid ka mid ah amarradaas.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Gacanta ka soo horjeeda {opp_idx} horey ayey u dhimatay.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split waa in ay bedeshaa qeybinta gacantaada.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Dhaqdhaqaaq aan ansax ahayn. Isticmaal [attack M O] ama [split L R].

game_action.attack: P{player_id} wuxuu weerarayaa P{opp_id} gacantiisa {opp_idx}: wuxuu ka socdaa {opp_val} ilaa {new_val}.

outcome.win: Labada gacmood ee qofka kaa soo horjeeda waa dhimanayaan.
